Time_synchronization.label: Time synchronization
Time_synchronization.description: The uCIFI time synchronization object enables a device to sync-up its internal clock with a remote NTP server.

NTP_server_address.label: NTP server address
NTP_server_address.description: Hostname or IP address of the Network Time Protocol server.

Backup_NTP_server_address.label: Backup NTP server address
Backup_NTP_server_address.description: Hostname or IP address of a backup NTP server to be used in case the main NTP server does not respond.

NTP_period.label: NTP period
NTP_period.description: Number of hours before which the device tries to reach the NTP server for time synchronization.

Last_time_sync.label: Last time sync
Last_time_sync.description: Last time at which a successful time synchronization occurred.

Time_sync_error.label: Time sync error
Time_sync_error.description: Set to True in case the latest time synchronization operation failed. Set to False in case the last operation succeeded.
